title: Translucent Buttons
description: Makes option buttons cleaner and translucent.
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d332cdab77737cd016fd7c1ae13efef260cbc7_0.webp)

**Translucent Buttons** gives the options buttons a cleaner, translucent texture that is set to an opacity that balances readability and aesthetics. Buttons now glow when hovered over instead of using an outline. Main and pause menu icons have been centered and improved. Longer sliders may appear bugged in snapshots.
